GROIN.gloss: the crease at the junction of the inner part of the thigh with the trunk together with…
GROIN.definition: The crease at the junction of the inner part of the thigh with the trunk together with the adjacent region and often including the external genitals.

IRON.gloss: a heavy ductile magnetic metallic element
IRON.definition: A heavy ductile magnetic metallic element; is silver-white in pure form but readily rusts; used in construction and tools and armament; plays a role in the transport of oxygen by the blood.

GRIN.gloss: a facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth
GRIN.definition: A facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually shows pleasure or amusement.

GIRO.gloss: a check given by the British government to someone who is unemployed
GIRO.definition: A check given by the British government to someone who is unemployed; it can be cashed either at a bank or at the post office.

ION.gloss: a particle that is electrically charged
ION.definition: A particle that is electrically charged (positive or negative); an atom or molecule or group that has lost or gained one or more electrons.

RIG.gloss: arrange the outcome of by means of deceit
RIG.definition: Arrange the outcome of by means of deceit.

GIN.gloss: strong liquor flavored with juniper berries
GIN.definition: Strong liquor flavored with juniper berries.
